item.name: Sister's Shroud

effects.title: Veiled
effects.text: When falling below 50% HP, gain 150% evasion for 5 seconds. While active, dodging an attack decreases the evasion bonus by 75% of its current value.

effects.title: Last Caress
effects.text: Veiled cooldown is only reset if the wearer dies or kills an enemy hero.

notes: Does not trigger from damage by non-player controlled creeps
item.lore: A pall that draped the sarcophagus of the First Sister.
